name: orbital-shift
description: Orbital-shift: a marketplace of intent-shaped Claude Code plugins. Skills are arranged in orbits around a shared core — formal-reasoning pipeline, architectural analysis, parallel orchestration, and developer utilities — each plugin answering one question about what invoking it does for you.

plugins.name: logic-focused
plugins.description: Formal logic reasoning pipeline: closed-world KB construction, proposition decomposition, model-based and Lean 4 proof verification, property instantiation as TDD tests, and proof-grounded specification realization.

plugins.name: c4-prolog
plugins.description: C4 architectural modeling and Prolog-based codebase analysis with atomized phase skills.

plugins.name: multi-plan
plugins.description: Parallel worktree orchestration with plan, review, human-vetting, implement, and commit cycles. Includes single-ticket-pipeline for end-to-end logic-focused runs on one ticket.

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Standalone developer utilities: logical commit generation, presentation creation, and bounded recurring loops.
